management-dashboard-skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the management-dashboard skill.
- Generates a management dashboard daily HTML report by summarizing AI-generated meeting content from recordings.
- Fetches recordings via paginated API using agentId resolved from current session, with strict handling of time ranges and empty data cases.
- Enforces report structure containing six core sections: team assets, field efficiency, compliance monitoring, RM ranking, lead conversion, and management advice.
- Ensures user receives only the generated file path as output, following prescribed workflow and error handling conventions.
